consent.title: Your health data
consent.body: Weight, food, workouts and photos are health data. We use them only to run the app: on this phone and, if you keep a copy on our server (in the EU), there too. Other users cannot see them. Our team can technically reach the server copy and its backups; we look only when needed to fix a problem, and every look is logged. With end-to-end encryption on, nobody but you can read it. You can export or delete everything at any time in Settings > Your data.

consent.title: Before you use the AI coach
consent.intro: The coach is an AI model. To answer you, the app has to send it what you write.
consent.whereIncluded: With the AI included in Premium, it goes through our server to OpenRouter (USA) and a provider that runs the AI model (now DeepSeek V4.1), picked among those that keep no data.
consent.whereOwn: With your own AI key, it goes straight from this device to the provider you chose ({{provider}}), under your agreement with them. Our server is not involved.
consent.what: What you write and the files and photos you attach are always sent: you choose them. Your stored data (body, diet, training, photos) is sent only for the kinds you allow below. They are all off until you turn them on.
consent.health: This can include health data, such as your weight, what you eat or your workouts.
consent.anonymous: It is sent without your name, email, account or device, and without your birth date (only your age, if you share your profile).
consent.noTraining: With the included AI, only providers that do not keep it and do not use it to train models are used.
consent.later: You can change what the coach sees in the AI coach settings, and withdraw this consent in Settings > Your data.
consent.declined: Nothing was sent. You can agree later in the AI coach settings.
consent.given: You agreed on {{date}}. Withdraw it in Settings > Your data.

vault.title: End-to-end encryption
vault.onDetail: On: our server keeps only encrypted data it cannot read. API and AI apps are off.
vault.offDetail: Off: the copy on the server is readable by the server (needed by the API and AI apps).
vault.webNote: To turn it on or off, use the FFT app on your phone.
vault.lockedDetail: This device does not have your key yet: enter your passphrase to sync it.
vault.onTitle: Encrypt the copy on the server?
vault.onBody: Your data is encrypted on this phone before it is sent, with a key only you have. Our server keeps it but cannot read it.

onPoints.api: The API and AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, MCP) stop working while encryption is on: they read the copy on the server.
onPoints.admin: Nobody at FFT can see your data on the server, only how much there is and when it changed.
onPoints.lost: If you lose both your passphrase and your recovery key, the copy on the server cannot be read by anyone. Your phone keeps its data.
onPoints.devices: Your other phones and the web app ask for the passphrase once.

vault.passphraseHint: Not your login password. At least {{count}} characters; a few words are easy to remember.
vault.notSame: The two passphrases are not the same.
vault.recoveryBody: If you forget your passphrase, this key opens your data. It is shown only now: write it down or keep it in a password manager.
vault.turnedOn: The copy on the server is now end-to-end encrypted.
vault.offBody: Your data is sent to our server again in a readable form, so the API and AI apps can work. The encrypted copy and your key are then deleted from the server.
vault.turnedOff: Encryption is off. The copy on the server is being sent again.
vault.newPassphraseBody: Your data stays as it is: only the lock of your key changes. Your recovery key keeps working.
vault.unlockBody: Enter the passphrase you chose for encryption (not your login password) to open your data on this device.
vault.wrong: That is not the right passphrase.
vault.wrongRecovery: That is not the right recovery key.
vault.failed: That did not work, nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
vault.apiOffTitle: API and AI apps are off
vault.apiOffBody: Your copy on the server is end-to-end encrypted, so our server cannot read it for Claude, ChatGPT or your own tools. Turn encryption off in Settings > Your data to use them.

relay.title: Sync with another phone
relay.intro: Your phones exchange changes through our server, end-to-end encrypted with a key that only your phones have (it travels in the code, never to the server). The server keeps no copy: each change is deleted as soon as your other phone has it, and anything not delivered after 30 days.
relay.serverCopyOn: Your phones already sync through the copy on the server. To sync them without keeping a copy on the server, turn that copy off first: the two cannot be on together.
relay.webNote: Pairing phones is done in the FFT app on your phones.
relay.codeBody: On the other phone, signed in to the same account: Settings > Your data > Sync with another phone > Scan a code. Or type the code below.
relay.codeWarning: Anyone with this code and your account could read your data: show it only to your own phones.
relay.scanBody: Point the camera at the code shown on your other phone, or type it.
relay.needCamera: The camera is needed to scan the code. You can also type it.
relay.invalid: That is not a pairing code. Check it and try again.
relay.paired: This phone is paired. Your data is being exchanged.
relay.removeBody: It stops receiving your changes, and what was waiting for it on the server is deleted. Its own data stays on it. To pair it again, scan the code again.
relay.leaveBody: This phone stops sending and receiving changes. Its data stays on it, and the other phones keep theirs.
relay.left: This phone no longer syncs with your other phones.
relay.alwaysSent: Always exchanged: your profile, your settings and your consents. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.
relay.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
relay.joinBody: This account keeps its data only on your phones. Scan the code shown on your other phone (Settings > Your data > Sync with another phone) to bring your data here.
relay.waiting: Paired. Waiting for your other phone: keep FFT open on it.
relay.endsRelay: Your phones now sync through the encrypted relay. Keeping a copy on the server replaces it: the relay stops (each phone keeps its data).
